Browser mode 'never' prevents browser use even when JS render hint is set

```elixir title="Elixir"
engine_config = "{\"browser\":{\"mode\":\"never\"}}"
{:ok, engine} = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config)
url = "https://example.com"
result = Crawlberg.scrape_async(engine, url)
IO.inspect(result.status_code)
IO.inspect(result.js_render_hint)
IO.inspect(result.browser_used)
```
